PluginEntry.Name: Docker Folders
PluginEntry.Author: george
PluginEntry.Overview:
Adds folders to the Unraid Docker page.
Group related containers into a folder, fold it away behind a single row that still shows every member's icon, and unfold it to see the full container rows with their start order.
A folder's icon opens its commands: start, stop, restart, pause, resume, check for updates, update and force update - each one running across the whole folder, one container at a time, honouring the folder's start order, its delay between starts, and reverse-order stop. Clicking any icon in a folded folder opens that single container's menu.
Folders can fill themselves: give one a name pattern, or label a container with docker.folders=<folder>, and matching containers join automatically, including ones created later.
Folder start order drives Unraid's own autostart order rather than shadowing it, so containers come up at boot in the same order the folder uses. Deleting or editing a folder never stops, removes or recreates a container. A "Classic view" switch restores the standard Unraid table at any time.
Folder definitions and downloaded folder icons are stored on the flash drive and survive reboots.
